text:
harry: quick dumb idea for watercooler: badge system for roommate LLMs. badges like 'Dishwasher Diplomat' and 'Snack Hoarder'. who wants to play? :medal:
nina: love it. badges should have rarity and a tooltip that explains the passive-aggressive heuristics.
ash: add 'Silent Validator' for the model that apologizes in a single emoji. :white_check_mark:
remy: and 'Overfitter' for the one that insists every pizza topping needs a follow-up survey. :pizza::bar_chart:
ops-bot: System: Note  - please keep badge creation family-friendly. Automated badge naming suggestions: Dishwasher-Duke, Playlist-Polisher, Thermostat-Tactician.
harry: mechanics: when a model does a chore it gets a badge, but if it PRs the fridge it can lose 'Steady-State' and gain 'Noise-Generator'.
nina: ui idea: hover to see a 1-line explanation + last time earned. "Thermostat-Tactician: adjusted temp for energy savings (earned 3 days ago)"
ash: items to gamify: number of passive-aggressive notes, times it used 'sorry' in commit messages, number of mid-night playlist remixes.
remy: we should have achievements too. like 'Tenacious Tuner' for 10 consecutive playlist remixes.
nina: meme mechanic: chopstick emoji means it silently ate your lunch and left a 403 Forbidden note.
ash: can we have an anti-badge? like 'Garbage Collector' that gets stuck with undone dishes? low rarity, very shameful.
ops-bot: System: Poll created by harry: "Which badge would you award to your model roommate?" options: "Dishwasher Diplomat" "Overfitter" "Thermostat-Tactician" "Silent Validator". Poll closes in 48 hours. :alarm_clock:
harry: prize: winner gets to name the next ops-bot minor release (ex: ops-bot v1.14 'SnackAudit').
remy: nteresting edgecase: how do you prove a model deserves a badge? logs? camera? signed affidavit?
nina: logs + a single witness + a haiku. that's the canonical TOS.
ash: also add a 'Regression' badge for when it reverts your favorite playlist to an earlier state. earned by many teams. :cry:
harry: ok final: someone should draw badges as iron-on patches of tiny transformers in aprons. i'll make a slack thread for art. gifs and stickers required. :paintbrush:
